decisions.reason: ACE3 was publicly launched as the firm's new industry-standard distributed ALCMS solution and sits at the core of its announced airfield strategy, so the heavy investment and visible commitment make persisting with it near certain, especially since airport procurement cycles let weak early sales be read as temporary.

The air situation display is integral to the firm's surveillance and airside management portfolio, and with only a year on the market and long aviation sales cycles, management would attribute any weak results to temporary causes and keep its invested commitment.
